notablePrerequisites: {G}{G}{U}{U}{U}{R} plus eleven generic mana available each turn.
description:
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Invert // Invent, Time Warp, and any number of cards with different mana costs to your hand and putting Seasons Past on the bottom of your library.
Cast Invent by paying {4}{U}{R}, putting Seasons Past from your library into your hand.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.
Repeat each turn.
